The **Set Payload** command lets you configure the payload (the combined weight of everything attached to the robot tool flange) at specific points in your program. [UR5e Cobot]

- When setting up the payload for a pick-and-place program using a gripper.

1. In your robot program, **select the node** where you wish to add the command.
2. Under **Basic**, tap **Set Payload**.
3. Use the **Select Payload** drop-down to either:
   - Select one of the payloads already configured in the installation, **or**

4. Optionally, use the **Set Now** button to immediately apply the values on the node as the active payload.

### Payload Transition Time
At the bottom of the screen, you can set a **transition time** (in seconds) between different payloads. Setting a transition time greater than zero prevents the robot from doing a small "jump" when the payload changes.
